selection_rules: The paper has a formally published or proceedings-backed identity.
The paper exposes a bounded procedural mechanism that can be atomized into 5-16 source-grounded units.
Two distinct implementation tasks can be scored with deterministic public and private fixtures.
The task does not require foundation-model retraining or access to proprietary training data.
Provider outcomes, V4/V5 private cases, and future private cases cannot influence paper or task selection.

replacement_policy.allowed_until: before the Stage 2.3 final materialization anchor is committed and before the first forward provider conversation
allowed_reasons: full text cannot be legally acquired
source spans cannot support a 5-16 atom registry
a deterministic private scorer cannot be constructed
the task requires unavailable proprietary data or foundation-model retraining
replacement_policy.procedure: Use the lowest-ranked eligible reserve from the same domain, write an immutable amendment with the reason and new hashes, verify it, commit it, and push it before any provider call.
replacement_policy.forbidden: No replacement or paper/task target rewrite after the Stage 2.3 final materialization anchor. No atom, artifact, fixture, scorer, registry, or schedule rewrite after that anchor, regardless of whether a private outcome has already been observed.

implementation_policy.external_code: Clean-room implementations from registered paper spans are the default. External code may be reused only after its source URL, revision, and license are captured in the adapter manifest.
implementation_policy.full_text_gate: Every selected unit must bind a locally preserved full-text digest and exact source spans before its Stage 2.3 provider pilot.
implementation_policy.private_fixture_gate: Every task needs disjoint public and private fixture registries with stable IDs, seeds, payload digests, and deterministic expected outputs.
implementation_policy.atom_gate: Each F must contain 5-16 source-addressed atoms; every dependency edge and primary strict subset S must pass closure and digest checks.
implementation_policy.independent_semantic_audit: Before the Stage 2.3 final anchor, a source auditor who did not construct S must review the task-to-span matrix, atom roles, DAG, F completeness, and scorer semantics. Builder and auditor identities plus disagreements and resolutions are recorded.
implementation_policy.task_specificity_gate: Every task must separate paper claims, implementation guardrails, and scorer-interface atoms; bind at least two central paper spans; show that its two tasks have distinct central source boundaries; and pass a reference-implementation differential test before provider use.
implementation_policy.private_registry_gate: Each task has registry_A and registry_B, three blocks each. Registry B must have a builder or auditor different from the candidate builder, disjoint cases/seeds/payloads, and a separate digest.
